subject: Urgent: One-off H400 allocation & tiered overage concession for Solvex AI
messages:
From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@solvex.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Need H400 allocation + overage concession to match PoC performance

Marissa / Laura,

Thanks again for the PoC support last week. The models we've been running in-house perform about 18% better (latency and stability) on NVIDIA H400 variants compared with the H100 family for our 8k-token streaming use case.

We have an inbound production launch in 6 weeks and would like a one-off allocation of dedicated H400 instances (12 GPUs) for an initial 3-month term. Two asks: 1) a tiered overage concession that caps overage at 1.5x list rate for the first 90 days, and 2) a temporary 15% usage credit for the first month to offset migration testing.

We understand H400 isn't in the usual SKU map; procurement asked if Redwood can sign off as an exception with an addendum to the SOW. Attached is our updated SOW. Happy to jump on a short call.

—Alex
Alex Ramos
Head of Infrastructure, Solvex AI
alex.ramos@solvex.ai
+1 (415) 555-0187
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 10:01:45 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Need H400 allocation + overage concession to match PoC performance

Looping you all in — Solvex (fast-growing consumer AI search) requests an out-of-catalog H400 allocation plus two commercial concessions.

Key points and current ask: 
- Dedicated: 12x H400 for 3 months (then evaluate for Dedicated commit)
- Overage: cap at 1.5x list for first 90 days
- One-month 15% usage credit (applied as bill credit)
- They want a short SOW addendum and DocuSign flow

Why this matters: Solvex is on track for a meaningful expansion if this launch hits target KPIs; they are willing to sign a 12-month dedicated commitment thereafter. Risk: precedent for H400 SKU and temporary overage cap.

Proposal for escalation: 
- Request conditional executive approval from Sales Ops and VP Sales to allow H400 transient allocation under strict guardrails: 6-month minimum notice-to-cancel, finance escrow for credits, and a hard cap on aggregated burst hours.
- Require Legal to add a one-off addendum limiting the concession window and adding cost pass-through for any unexpected infra premium.

Can you weigh in on appetite to approve with these constraints? I attached their SOW and a quick cost model.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive — Strategic Deals
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Solvex_SOW_draft_v2.pdf (pdf), Cost_Model_Solvex.xlsx (xlsx)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 08:30:12 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Need H400 allocation + overage concession to match PoC performance

Thanks for the summary, Marissa. High-level thoughts:

1) Commercially Im inclined to approve a tightly-scoped exception if we can:
   - Condition approval on conversion mechanics: Solvex must commit to a 12-month dedicated term within 90 days of launch or pay a defined make-good for credits.
   - Limit the H400 allocation to an explicit burst pool (12 GPUs, max 20% utilization as burst) and require a daily utilization report for the first 30 days.

2) Pricing guardrails: 15% month-one credit is acceptable if finance can escrow the credit amount up front (or include in SOW as a conditional credit applied after month-end reconciliation). The 1.5x overage cap for 90 days is OK provided legal inserts language allowing us to pass through any third-party infra premium attributable to H400 procurement.

3) Operational: Jonas — can your team guarantee the H400 availability in the us-west-2 window for the requested start date (2028-05-01)? If not, we need a fallback plan to H100-compatible variant with pre-announced performance delta.

If ops and legal greenlight, I'll provide exec sign-off with the above constraints. We should also capture a short internal precedent note to avoid open-ended expectations.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@solvex.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Apr 2028 14:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Need H400 allocation + tiered overage concession for Solvex AI

Marissa / Karthik / Jonas / Alex —

I approve a one-time exception on the following terms: 
- Provision 12x H400 in us-west-2 as a dedicated transient pool starting 2028-05-01 for an initial 3-month window.
- Overage: capped at 1.5x list for the initial 90 days.
- Credit: 15% usage credit applied as a post-billing adjustment for month one; finance will escrow credit amount or include as line item in the SOW.
- Commercial conditions: Solvex signs an addendum agreeing to convert to a 12-month commitment within 90 days post-launch or reimburse the credits pro-rata.
- Operational guardrails: daily utilization telemetry for the first 30 days and a hard burst cap (20% of pool per day).
- Legal to include pass-through carve-out for third-party infra premiums and a clause that this approval is non-precedential.

Jonas: coordinate the capacity reservation and confirm an ops timeline by end of day Monday. Marissa: please get the addendum updated and push DocuSign with the escrow terms. Karthik: I'll loop in Finance to confirm escrow workflow.

Alex: welcome aboard — happy we could move quickly on this. Please note these are one-time exceptions and will be tied to the SOW addendum.

—Lauren
